list.about: 1.000 unequal rows virtualized inside a scroller — the biggest list a real screen shows.

text.about: Three columns of wrapped prose at three point sizes, one of them capped and ellipsized.

motion.about: Twelve rows of toggles, bars and a Collapse, measured MID-transition instead of at rest.

dense-loop.about: A populated screen with a Spinner running — the steady animation frame.

dense-caret.about: The same screen with nothing looping, so a focused field's caret owns the clock alone.
